description: DeFi lending and stable yield benchmark from DeFiLlama Yields — top pools by APY with p25/p50/p75 APY bands, TVL, chain, and pool id. Optional protocol (project slug substring) and/or asset (symbol substring). With no filters, universe is stablecoin-marked pools (typical lending / money-market supply). Free public API, no key. $0.02 USDC per call.

asset.description: Filter by pool symbol substring, e.g. USDC, DAI, ETH

protocol.description: Filter by DeFiLlama project slug substring, e.g. aave-v3, compound-v3

name: get_defi_yield_benchmark
